subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should builtin memorySearch.extraPaths ingest arbitrary JSONL raw message logs, or should raw JSONL recall stay in documented session-memory, QMD, converter, or plugin-owned workflows?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but widening builtin ingestion changes sensitive raw-log visibility and may conflict with lean-core/plugin-boundary guidance unless maintainers explicitly sponsor the behavior.

options.title: Document Supported Alternative
options.body: Keep builtin memory extra paths Markdown/multimodal-only and document QMD, session-memory, converter, or plugin-owned workflows for raw JSONL recall.

options.title: Add Native Builtin JSONL
options.body: Implement JSONL as a first-class builtin memory format with line-aware parsing, memory_get, watcher, tests, docs, and privacy/visibility guardrails.

options.title: Design Plugin/API First
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers decide whether a plugin or memory API extension should own arbitrary raw-log ingestion.

recommendation.title: Document Supported Alternative
recommendation.body: Keep builtin memory extra paths Markdown/multimodal-only and document QMD, session-memory, converter, or plugin-owned workflows for raw JSONL recall.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already supplied the relevant keep-open analysis and has the strongest recent history around the memory host/runtime boundary.
